title: Coalesce work-scoped memory changes in next delivery to the current head, without historical titles or staged-replay old versions
outcome: Coalesce work-scoped memory changes in next delivery to the current head, without historical titles or staged-replay old versions
acceptance: When a next delivery cursor spans several versions of one work-scoped memory, the agent sees only the current version's change; superseded titles or bodies from historical feed entries or staged-page replay are not shown
Feed positions, cursors and replay determinism are unchanged; a regression covers multi-revision work memories across paging and restart
